decisions.reason: The source places booking functionality on location websites but does not change the existing rule that each location maintains its own calendar.
The source addresses booking-system placement only and does not change location-specific payment processing or payment setup.
Moving booking functionality off the master site does not alter the requirement for separate revenue and sales tracking by location.
The source does not change separate payouts, Wix accounts, or payment setups for the locations.
The existing master-site routing to each location website remains valid; the source only clarifies that booking occurs after that routing.
The source relies on the already-established separate-location-website model but does not modify that model.
Booking-system placement does not change the requirement that packages and prices remain consistent across location websites.
The source does not change the master website domain or any domain-to-website mapping.
The decision about where bookings are handled does not alter the visual layout, navigation reference, or shared site template.
Excluding a booking system from the master site does not necessarily prohibit reuse of booking-related informational content or other legacy materials.
The legacy site's required availability and the master site's linkage to it remain unchanged when bookings are handled on the location website.
Booking-system placement has no effect on the Shatter House brand name or Ridgehaven brand identity.
